scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,worker,web -c blue,yellow,magenta "npm run dev -w apps/server" "npm run dev:worker -w apps/server" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/server && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w apps/server && npm run typecheck -w apps/web
